requiredPrimaryCuts.sign-greek-cyrillic-companion: Four genuine native upright cuts or authored variable instances; retain native names, rights and coherent whole-script runs.

methodBoundaries: Main, auxiliary, numbers, punctuation and index sets are separate. Latin auxiliary is required by this profile; wider Greek and Cyrillic auxiliary remains a separate source question.
Case closure is not a complete locale-sensitive casing API. Explicit Lithuanian input and mark contexts are tested separately.
Nominal missing scalars and actual shaping failures are distinct. Retain the actual source controls.
CJK resource labels do not perform Unicode script itemisation. Regional forms, bidi, line breaking and native quality require appropriate evidence.
Glyph presence, compilation and virtual model outputs do not establish passenger recognition.

The selected CLDR 49 Yoruba profile uses dot-below inputs. The current Sign source also includes distinct U+0329 vertical-line-below inputs from other primary inventories. Canonical normalisation does not replace one encoding with the other; actual sequences are checked separately.

signFigures.default: Retain native proportional figures and spacing.

currentProduction.componentsAndInstructions: Flatten nested components and decompose transformed components; regenerate output instructions with the exact external tool and fixed options in tools/production.json. Retained contours are checked after explicit integer/direction normalisation; native source assembly remains in UFO history.
currentProduction.smallCaps: Reuse only genuine native case-linked companions and documented native constructions. The new U+1E7D and U+1E8B companions use their uppercase c2sc partner routes. U+1E0A c2sc and U+1E0B smcp use the native D smallcap and zero-width dot above, replacing the inherited wrong below-dot route. No identity substitutions or generic cap scaling.
newInputCases: Sign U0329 and its tone/below-base routes.
Sign six scoped missing-vowel combinations, native x+0307 and the context-only U1ECB soft-dot alternate.
Screen AEIOUaeiou+1DC5 in four repaired uprights, with contextual native dotlessi; four italic routes preserved.
Screen T+035F+H and t+035F+h preserve actual native pair spacing and span both bases.
Screen newly encoded canonical combinations retain native pair-role spacing in NFC and NFD.
currentProduction.primaryQA: Run the complete pinned googlefonts profile with each applicable family OFL input, retaining all raw severities and context skips.
